niche: a coastal combined heat and power plant's winter coal reserve, measured from a year of monthly drone surveys of its coal yard flown by two survey contractors in different grids and height systems
analyst_test: With both contractors' surveys aligned and the fuel security procedure applied as written, a strong analyst takes each coal pile's December volume above a plane fitted through its toe, the stock surveyor's standard base, which the new pile area's own bare surveys and the year's book roll-forward both confirm, and files about 140,000 t, 57.5 days against the 60-day floor, nominating the winter option cargo.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a stockpile inventory worked the way a stock-survey team integrates its surveys, each pile's volume between the December surface and the pad beneath it with the base surface conformed from the year's surveys across two contractors' grids and height systems; in another field's nouns the task is gone, because what decides is a yard pad consolidating under coal piles on reclaimed harbour land, seen only where a pile was reclaimed to the pad.
layer2_pattern: own:stockpile base surface where the pad has settled under long-standing piles
layer1: two survey contractors on different grids (the plant grid, ETRS-TM35FIN) and height systems (N60, N2000)
ESRI ASCII grids against semicolon XYZ exports with decimal commas
NODATA cells where a machine stood on a pile
the fuel laboratory's density unit changed mid-year (kg/m3 to t/m3)
the port's berth log in UTC against the plant's Finnish time

spine.entity: one surveyed point of the coal yard surface

world.geography: Finland (a fictional coastal city's energy company on the Gulf of Bothnia)
world.org_type: municipal combined heat and power company

driver: The decisive quantity is the amount held above a surface that has sunk beneath the loads it carries, so under each load it lies below the level at the load's edge; the record shows that surface only on the occasions each load was taken away, and an amount taken against a surface through the load's edge leaves out the part filling the hollow.
driver_concrete: Each coal pile's tonnage at the December 2026 survey is its volume above the yard pad as the year's surveys expose it in the month the pile was reclaimed to the pad, aligned across the two contractors' grids and height systems, times its coal's bulk density, not its volume above a plane through its toe, which leaves out the coal lying in the bowl the pad has settled into under decades of stockpiling.
stump: The default path takes each pile's December volume above a plane fitted through its toe and files a reserve of about 140,000 t, 57.5 days against the 60-day floor, so it nominates the winter option cargo; the pad under the five long-standing piles has settled into bowls up to about one and a half metres deep, and measured against the pad the year's rotations exposed the reserve is about 151,000 t, 62.1 days, and no cargo is needed.

differentiation.task190: task190 v6 reads a ratio's precision from its design variance; here the decisive step is the surface a stockpile volume is taken against, measured from the survey archive, with no variance or interval in the call
differentiation.task195: task195 judges a paired difference's uncertainty; here nothing is inferential: the decisive step is the base under each coal pile, read from the surveys that expose the pad
differentiation.task228: task228's lineage separates comparators' correlated errors; here the decisive step is a base surface conformed from a year of surveys across two contractors' frames, with no comparator or error model
differentiation.task478: task478 v7 corrects a period total for an input property a supplier records; here the decisive step is the pad under each pile, seen in the year's own surveys where the pile was reclaimed to the pad

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the re-check under the new gates: the golden was the field's own POD-corrected aerial methane inventory (each plume over its detection probability fitted to the provider's controlled releases) applied as the literature states it, so the field's method was the top rung rather than rung 0 or 1 (Link, Reflex, Back-test, Second use and Shock fail on the honest anatomy); its shipped pack, target.zip 33e6d0c4, stays at the portal pending; re-rooted 2026-11-04 into a new domain, world, dataset and shell
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a period total of many intermittent sources seen only through a few snapshot surveys, each of which records a source only while it is active and then only with a probability that rises with its size, so a blank at a surveyed place is partly a miss: each detection has to stand for the instances its detection probability implies, measured on blind trials of known size, while counting blanks as zeros understates the units whose total sits in many small sources and carrying each detected source through the period overstates the units whose total sits in large intermittent ones.
lineage.stump: The default path averages each producer's plume rates over its passes and campaigns, counting every imaged site without a plume as zero, and rates eight producers low-methane, among them Anchell, Pinyon Draw, Pellisto and Ashmund (0.150, 0.155, 0.179 and 0.181 per cent), whose methane leaks from many 5 to 15 kg/h sources a pass catches less than half the time; carrying each detected source through the year instead rates none; only weighting each plume by one over the detection probability at its rate, fitted to the provider's blind controlled releases, rates the golden four.
lineage.niche: measurement-based methane intensity of gas producers from repeated aerial plume surveys, for an emissions data company's low-methane rating

notes: architecture 2 re-root 2026-11-04 after architecture 1 was found spent at the 2026-11-02 re-check (its golden was the field's own method applied as stated); first drawn in a steelworks' ore yard, redrawn into a CHP plant's coal yard the same day when task476 v4 and task488 v2 registered first. Designed to the survivor anatomy: the field's method (a base through the toe) is rung 0 and validates on the new pile area and on the book roll-forward; the decisive step is recognising that the long-standing piles violate its precondition (the pad under a pile continues the pad at its toe), forced by the year's own surveys with no filed method and no outside constant.
